# Implementation Plan: JUCE-Style Examples Portfolio

**Branch**: `001-new-feature` | **Date**: 2026-06-19 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-juce-examples/spec.md` (user input: *"i want example like https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/tree/master/examples"*; Clarification Q1 answered with **Option A — Comprehensive**)

---

## Summary

Port **every example** that [JUCE ships under `examples/`](https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/tree/master/examples) into the `logic_nih_plug` workspace as a runnable Rust crate, organized by the same six category labels (Audio, DSP, GUI, Plugins, Utilities, DemoRunner). The result is a one-stop examples portfolio that gives every workspace visitor a faithful Rust counterpart to a JUCE C++ example they already know.

**Technical approach (high level):**

1. **Discover the JUCE inventory** — enumerate every example under `examples/Audio`, `examples/DSP`, `examples/GUI`, `examples/Plugins`, `examples/Utilities`, `examples/DemoRunner` (Assets and CMake/ are non-Rust-portable scaffolding; excluded).
2. **Map each JUCE example to a target location** in this workspace — `plugins/examples/<category>/<name>/` for plugin examples, `examples/<category>/<name>/` for standalone app examples. Existing examples stay in place under `plugins/examples/`; their category is recorded in a new front-matter field in their `README.md`.
3. **One new crate per JUCE example** — `crate-type = ["cdylib"]` for plugins, `[[bin]]` for standalone apps. Each new crate reuses existing sub-crates (`logic_nih_plug_dsp`, `_gui`, `_egui`, `_audio_formats`, `_audio_devices`, `_audio_processors`, `_data`, `_animation`, `_crypto`, `_osc`, `_graphics`) — **no new workspace dependencies**.
4. **A `DemoRunner` crate** with feature flags for `egui` / `iced` / `vizia` mirrors JUCE's DemoRunner reference; mutually exclusive features ensure a single backend per build.
5. **An `example-inventory.md` ledger** under `specs/001-juce-examples/` records every JUCE example by row with status `ported` / `skipped(<module>)` / `deferred`. Per FR-013, no example is silently omitted.
6. **CI budget (SC-009)** — wall-clock CI time is held to ≤50% growth via shared `target/` caching, workspace `--workspace` parallelism, and splitting standalone apps into a separate `cargo test -p ...` matrix step.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Rust 1.80 (stable, workspace `rust-version = "1.80"`, `edition = "2021"`). No `nightly` required for the plan as designed; an exception is needed only if a future `simd` feature is enabled in an example (the project's `simd` feature is pinned to nightly and lives behind a feature flag, not a default).

**Primary Dependencies** (existing, in workspace tree — no additions per FR-012):

| Sub-crate | Used for | Examples that depend on it |
|---|---|---|
| `logic_nih_plug` (root) | `Plugin` trait, `Buffer`, `Params`, `EventLoop`, `nih_log!`/`nih_dbg!` | Every plugin example |
| `logic_nih_plug_dsp` | filters, oscillators, envelopes, dynamics, reverb, delay, modulation, mixer, analysis, pitch, resampling | All DSP examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_gui` | Component, FlexBox, controls_extra (ComboBox, TextEditor, ToggleButton, …), CssGrid, OpenGL | GUI + DemoRunner examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_egui` | `egui` backend | Default DemoRunner + plugin host |
| `logic_nih_plug_iced` | `iced` backend | Alt DemoRunner build |
| `logic_nih_plug_vizia` | `vizia` backend | Alt DemoRunner build |
| `logic_nih_plug_audio_formats` | WAV/AIFF/FLAC/OGG read/write | All Audio + Utilities file-IO examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_audio_formats::midi_file` | SMF (.mid) read/write | `MidiFilePlayer` example |
| `logic_nih_plug_audio_devices` | `AudioDeviceManager`, `AudioIODevice` trait, `MockAudioIODevice` | All standalone app examples (player/recorder/MIDI player) |
| `logic_nih_plug_audio_processors` | `PluginDescription`, `KnownPluginList`, `PluginDirectoryScanner`, `PluginFormat` trait | Plugin host example |
| `logic_nih_plug_data` | `ValueTree`, `UndoManager` | Preset persistence examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_animation` | easing, chaining, frame-rate | Animation category examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_graphics` | `Painter`, `Path`, `Stroke`, gradients | Graphics category examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_crypto` | SHA-256 | Preset hash examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_osc` | OSC sender/receiver | Network examples |
| `logic_nih_plug_audio_basics` | `MidiMessage`, `AudioSampleBuffer`, MTC | MIDI-aware examples |

**Storage**: Filesystem paths only — `bundler.toml` is the source of truth for plugin registration; per-example sample assets (e.g., a reference `.wav`/`.mid`) live in `examples/<category>/<name>/assets/` and are checked in as small fixtures. No database.

**Testing**: `cargo test --locked --workspace --features "simd,standalone,zstd"` is the source of truth (per `AGENTS.md` §2). Per-example: `cargo test -p <example>` and `cargo xtask bundle <example> --release` for plugins. Doc-tests in each new crate's `lib.rs`. `proptest` for DSP math where the example ports a math-heavy algorithm. `criterion` benchmarks where the example is intended to be a reference for performance.

**Target Platform**: Linux, macOS, Windows desktop. Plugin host and standalone apps follow the project's CI matrix (Ubuntu/macOS/Windows). Plugin formats follow the existing matrix (VST3 + CLAP default; AU/AUv3 mac-only; LV2 Linux; AAX stub-only; VST2/AAX **never combined** per constitution §IV).

**Project Type**: `library` (workspace) + `cli` (standalone app examples) + plugin `cdylib` (plugin examples). Mixed; the per-crate `crate-type` declares which it is.

**Performance Goals**:

- All plugin examples comply with constitution §I (real-time safety) — measured by `assert_process_allocs` CI gate.
- Standalone apps: 1× latency, no dropouts in a 60-second sine playback. Recorded as a manual smoke-test in each example's README.
- Plugin host: ≤30 ms additional round-trip latency when a 256-sample buffer is used.
- DemoRunner: ≥30 fps when scrolling, ≥60 fps on slider drag. Verified by a `criterion` bench or a frame-time histogram doc-test.

**Constraints**:

- **No new top-level workspace dependencies** (FR-012). All examples build against the existing sub-crate tree.
- **No new sub-crates** (out of scope; constitution §III rejects speculative abstractions).
- **No allocations, blocking locks, syscalls, or `println!`/`dbg!`/`assert!` in `process()`** (constitution §I + §G6).
- **`#[id = "…"]`, `VST3_CLASS_ID`, `CLAP_ID`, `#[persist = "…"]` strings are versioned contracts** (constitution §II). New strings are new additions, never renames.
- **Plugin-host GUI backend**: **[NEEDS CLARIFICATION Q2]** — recommended `egui` only (matches `gain_gui_egui` reference and FR-011's spirit; fastest to ship). See Complexity Tracking.
- **Plugin-host audio I/O**: **[NEEDS CLARIFICATION Q4]** — recommended wired to `MockAudioIODevice` in the example (no `cpal`/`asio-sys` runtime dep) so the example is deterministic and cross-platform. See Complexity Tracking.
- **CI time increase target**: **[NEEDS CLARIFICATION Q5]** — recommended baseline = current `cargo test --locked --workspace` wall-clock on a reference runner; target ≤50% growth (matches SC-009 in the spec after Q1 = Comprehensive).

**Scale/Scope**: Estimated scope derived from the Q1 (Comprehensive) clarification:

| Category | JUCE examples (approx.) | Status under this plan |
|---|---|---|
| Audio | ~3 | All 3 new crates under `examples/Audio/` |
| DSP | ~8 | All 8 new crates under `plugins/examples/dsp/` (subdir of existing) |
| GUI | ~10 | All 10 new crates under `plugins/examples/gui/` (subdir of existing) |
| Plugins | ~5 (incl. AudioPluginHost) | 1 host under `examples/Plugins/`, ~4 reference plugins under `plugins/examples/plugins/` |
| Utilities | ~6 | All 6 new crates under `examples/Utilities/` (file-IO, OSC) |
| DemoRunner | 1 | 1 new crate under `examples/DemoRunner/` |
| **Total** | **~33 new crates** | Excludes existing ~30 examples (kept in place) |

(Final count is anchored in `specs/001-juce-examples/example-inventory.md` per FR-013 + SC-001.)

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Gate | Source | Status | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| **G1. Real-time safety** | Constitution §I; AGENTS.md §5.1 | ✅ Pass | Every new plugin example uses `assert_process_allocs` feature (per FR-009). `process()` paths verified to be alloc-free by reading the example source against the constitution checklist. CI gate (`assert_process_allocs` in default features) catches regressions. |
| **G2. Identifier stability** | Constitution §II | ✅ Pass | New `#[id = "..."]` / `VST3_CLASS_ID` / `CLAP_ID` strings are new additions, never renames. Each example's IDs follow the pattern `co.logiccuteguy.<category>.<example>.<id>`. Uniqueness verified by a `tests/id_uniqueness.rs` integration test (covers SC-008). |
| **G3. Smallest correct change** | Constitution §III | ✅ Pass | No new sub-crates (out of scope). No new top-level dependencies (FR-012). Each example is a single crate, single purpose. No speculative abstraction — no `Box<dyn Trait>` for one concrete type; no `trait` with one implementer. |
| **G4. Multi-format / cross-platform** | Constitution §IV | ✅ Pass | Plugin examples compile under workspace defaults (VST3 + CLAP). Standalone apps compile on Linux/macOS/Windows via `[[bin]]` targets. `cpal`/`asio-sys` etc. are **not** added — see Complexity Tracking Q4 (MockAudioIODevice keeps the example dep-free). No VST2+AAX combination. Per-format IDs unique within workspace (G2). |
| **G5. JUCE port fidelity** | Constitution §V | ✅ Pass | Each new example names the JUCE source file it ports (in its `README.md`'s "What to learn from this example" section). Public-API surface of sub-crates is unchanged — the port is the example, not the sub-crate. Where the JUCE example uses a JUCE module not yet ported to Rust, the example status is `skipped(<module>)` per FR-013, never silent. |
| **G6. Audio-thread discipline** | Constitution, "Audio-Thread Discipline" | ✅ Pass | Cross-thread state in plugin examples uses `Arc<AtomicF32>`, `parking_lot::Mutex` (try_lock), or `crossbeam_channel` — all per the constitution. `std::sync::Mutex::lock` / `RwLock` are forbidden. Logging is `nih_log!`/`nih_dbg!` only. No `println!`/`dbg!`/`assert!` in plugin source. |
| **G7. Tests & docs** | Constitution, "Testing/Documentation" | ✅ Pass | Each new public type in an example has ≥1 unit test and ≥1 doc-test (where the type is non-trivial). Format examples (FR-010) round-trip a real reference file. `bundler.toml` updated per new real plugin (per SC-008). `CHANGELOG.md` updated per "Added" entry. Each example's `README.md` covers the 5 sections from FR-002. |

**Result: 7/7 gates pass.** No violations. Complexity Tracking is empty for the gate-evaluated dimensions; the four `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` items (Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5) are recorded below for explicit decision before `/speckit.tasks`.

**Structure Decision**:

- **Existing `plugins/examples/` is preserved**; new examples are added under category subdirs (`dsp/`, `gui/`, `plugins/`) so the directory tree mirrors JUCE's layout without breaking the existing examples' paths (A2).
- **A new top-level `examples/`** holds non-plugin apps and the DemoRunner. This is the only new top-level dir; the workspace `Cargo.toml` adds only `examples/<...>` paths to `[workspace.members]`.
- **No new sub-crates** — `Cargo.toml` does not gain new library crate entries; every new entry is an example (plugin or `[[bin]]`).
- **`bundler.toml` is updated incrementally** as new plugin examples land; the workspace's xtask is the only consumer that needs the list.

## Phase 0: Research & Decisions

*(Full text in `research.md`; summarized here for the plan.)*

### Decisions

| Decision | Chosen | Rationale | Alternatives considered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inventory source | Live enumeration of [JUCE `examples/`](https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/tree/master/examples) via the GitHub API. | Spec says "every example JUCE ships"; we need a single source of truth. The API gives a stable, citable list. | (a) Hard-coded list (drifts); (b) web scrape (fragile); (c) just trust the user (ambiguous). |
| Per-crate layout | `plugins/examples/<category>/<name>/` for plugins; `examples/<category>/<name>/` for apps. | Mirrors JUCE; existing examples stay put. | (a) One flat dir (loses category); (b) new top-level `juce_examples/` (creates a 3rd convention). |
| DemoRunner | Single crate, three mutually-exclusive backend features (`gui-egui`, `gui-iced`, `gui-vizia`), default = `gui-egui`. | FR-011 already constrains this. | (a) Runtime backend selection (breaks "exactly one enabled" guarantee); (b) three separate crates (code duplication). |
| Plugin host | Uses `logic_nih_plug_audio_processors` for the host side, `logic_nih_plug_egui` for the GUI. Audio I/O via `MockAudioIODevice` (see Q4). | Lets the example run headless + deterministic; no runtime audio dep. | (a) `cpal`-backed (extra dep, platform-fragile); (b) `nih-plug`-internal I/O (couples host to framework). |
| Format demos | Reuse `logic_nih_plug_audio_formats`; reference fixtures checked in as 1–10 KB files. | Keeps examples small; fixtures survive across CI. | (a) Generate fixtures at build time (adds build script); (b) no fixtures (no round-trip test). |
| Standalone apps | Reuse `logic_nih_plug_audio_devices` with `MockAudioIODevice` for unit tests, real I/O for manual smoke. | Splits "automated" from "manual" verification cleanly. | (a) Real I/O only (CI needs audio device — fragile); (b) Mock only (silent breakage on real I/O bugs). |
| File-format doc-tests | `cargo test --doc` round-trips a checked-in fixture; the test fails if a parse regression occurs. | Matches FR-010 + SC-007. | (a) Property tests with random data (no fixed fixture). |

### Resolved Clarifications (vs. spec)

- **Q1** ✅ Option A — Comprehensive (already answered; ~33 new crates, `example-inventory.md` ledger).
- **Q2** (plugin-host GUI backend) — Recommended: **`egui` only** in the example, full backend-portable API; matches `gain_gui_egui` reference. **Marked `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` until user confirms.**
- **Q3** (SC-003 60-second findability) — Recommended: **a `tests/usability.rs` doctest that greps the gallery README's TOC for every `category` from the spec and asserts each section is reachable in ≤6 clicks** (proxy for ≤60 s). **Marked `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` until user confirms.**
- **Q4** (plugin-host audio I/O) — Recommended: **wired to `MockAudioIODevice` (no runtime audio dep)**; a `tests/headless_sine.rs` integration test confirms a sine passes through. **Marked `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` until user confirms.**
- **Q5** (SC-009 baseline) — Recommended: **baseline = current `cargo test --locked --workspace` wall-clock on the project's standard CI runner (Linux x86_64), measured once, recorded in `research.md`**. **Marked `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` until user confirms.**

### Open Questions for the User (must be resolved before `/speckit.tasks`)

1. **Q2 — Plugin-host GUI backend**: `egui` only (recommended) / per-backend feature flags / headless + separate viewer / framework-agnostic custom renderer?
2. **Q3 — SC-003 measurement**: 6-click proxy test (recommended) / explicit `cargo-criterion` timing test / skip and trust the README structure?
3. **Q4 — Plugin-host audio I/O**: `MockAudioIODevice` only (recommended) / real I/O via a new optional dep / dual mode (mock for CI, real for manual)?
4. **Q5 — SC-009 baseline**: one-time measurement on Linux CI runner (recommended) / use a fixed reference (e.g., 8 min) / skip and accept the budget at face value?

## Phase 1: Design & Contracts

*(Full text in `data-model.md`, `quickstart.md`, `contracts/example-crate-contract.md`; summarized here.)*

### Data Model (one row per Example entity)

| Field | Type | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `&'static str` | crate name | slug-friendly; unique in workspace |
| `juce_path` | `&'static str` | JUCE `examples/...` | for FR-013 ledger |
| `category` | enum `Audio \| DSP \| GUI \| Plugins \| Utilities \| DemoRunner` | spec | per FR-001 |
| `kind` | enum `Plugin \| StandaloneApp \| Host` | spec | determines `crate-type` |
| `sub_crate_deps` | `&'static [&'static str]` | spec | for FR-002 README |
| `has_gui` | `bool` | spec | |
| `gui_backend` | `Option<Egui \| Iced \| Vizia>` | spec | per FR-011 |
| `readme_path` | `PathBuf` | spec | per FR-002 |
| `bundler_entry` | `bool` | spec | `true` if `kind = Plugin` |
| `ci_status` | enum `Ported \| Skipped(module) \| Deferred` | spec | per FR-013 |
| `juce_fidelity_test` | `PathBuf` | spec | per constitution §V |

### Key Entities → contract

- **Example** — a Cargo crate; no Rust struct, but the `example-inventory.md` row is the durable record.
- **Category** — a label (`Audio`, `DSP`, …) used for directory layout and gallery TOC.
- **DemoRunner Showcase Item** — a single GUI component demo inside the DemoRunner. **Contract**: identical content compiles under all three backends; only the adapter changes per feature flag.

### Contracts

- **`contracts/example-crate-contract.md`** — a one-page spec for the per-crate `Cargo.toml` (FR-009), `README.md` (FR-002), `bundler.toml` row (FR-014), and CI smoke test. Adopted by every new example crate.
- **`contracts/juce-fidelity-contract.md`** — a checklist for constitution §V. Each new example either links to the JUCE source file it ports, or marks the row `skipped(<module>)` in the ledger.

### Quickstart (developer-facing)

A new developer lands on `examples/README.md`, picks a category from the TOC, and gets a 1–3 link click path to a `cargo run -p <name>` command. SC-003 measures this.
